name: Classic Washed
description: A clarity-focused washed process using controlled fermentation and clean water management to highlight origin character, structured acidity, and sweetness.

name: Slow Dried Natural
description: A natural process dried slowly to build sweetness, body, and layered fruit character while reducing harsh ferment notes.

name: Dual Phase Natural
description: A two-stage fermentation system using an initial aerobic phase followed by anaerobic fermentation to create fruit complexity, sweetness, and cleaner fermentation structure.

name: Lalvin Yeast Natural
description: A yeast-inoculated natural process using Lalvin yeast to guide fermentation toward clean fruit aromatics, floral expression, and juicy acidity.

name: Mossto Natural
description: A natural process using mossto, the active liquid from previous fermentation, to intensify fruit complexity, sweetness, and microbial consistency.

name: Thermal Shock Natural
description: An experimental natural process using controlled temperature contrast to influence cellular breakdown, sweetness extraction, and aromatic intensity.
